articles.title: This man refused life-saving treatment because of his religion - days later the rules changed

events.summary: Jehovah's Witness leaders have relaxed their long-standing restrictions on blood transfusions. The policy revision occurred weeks after a follower died from refusing life-saving treatment under the prior rule.
events.why: A major doctrinal shift on medical treatment directly impacts life-and-death healthcare decisions for millions of adherents globally.

articles.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster

events.summary: European prosecutors have launched an investigation into the potential misuse of EU funds designated for railway upgrades in Spain. The probe follows a train disaster in Urda that killed 69 people.
events.why: The investigation highlights systemic oversight failures and financial fraud tied directly to deadly critical infrastructure failures.

articles.title: With Stephen Miller pick, Trump readies for a battle

events.summary: President Trump has named Stephen Miller as his new White House chief of staff. The appointment is expected to lead to heightened confrontations between the administration and Congress.
events.why: The appointment of a new White House chief of staff strongly influences executive governance, federal administrative policy, and legislative negotiations.

articles.title: Watch: Is it the end of the road for Tesla's Cybertruck?

events.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced that Cybertruck production will halt in Texas. The company plans to shift its manufacturing focus toward self-driving Cybercabs.
events.why: A strategic shift by a leading automaker away from consumer utility vehicles toward autonomous transport affects the EV supply chain and technological deployment.

articles.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values

events.summary: AI stocks have rebounded following a major sell-off that erased trillions in market value. The previous slump was partly fueled by investor concerns over potential regulatory slowdowns following an election.
events.why: Fluctuations involving trillions in market value indicate significant volatility and investor sentiment shifts in the critical tech and AI sector.

articles.title: Former Palestinian detainees at mercy of Israel amid perpetual detention

events.summary: Former Palestinian detainees in the West Bank face repeated detentions by Israeli security forces. The continuous detentions are significantly impacting their families.
events.why: Highlights ongoing human rights and security challenges regarding administrative and repetitive detention in occupied territories.
